summary: Diff adds reusable AdSense components (script loader + ad slot) and inserts them into the main content flow for the standard BottomNav layout and for the referral redirect route’s loading/error states. One potential gap is that the referral redirect route renders no content (and thus no ad insertion) in the success state before navigation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the referral redirect route (currentSection starting with "r/") still includes the content-area ad insertion without interfering with redirect behavior.
missing_requirements.reason: In the referral redirect component, ads are rendered only for the "loading" and "error" UI branches. When status is "success", the component returns null, so there is no <main>-content ad insertion present during the success/redirect state.
evidence: frontend/src/app/referral/ReferralRedirect.tsx (GlobalContentAds present in loading/error returns; final `return null;` for other states including success)
